title: World Check MCP Values
description: Values for the World Check MCP Helm chart. A Python FastMCP server on the base chart. Exposure uses base chart Gateway API routes (no custom Ingress).

envVars.description: Additional environment variables in native Kubernetes syntax (e.g. valueFrom secretKeyRef). Required: ELICITATION_REQUEST_STATE_KEYS, a JSON list of keys of at least 32 characters from a secret, shared by every replica so an approval answered on another pod opens. The first key seals, every key opens, so rotate in two stages: deploy [old, new] to every replica, then [new, old], and keep the old key until outstanding approvals expire. Also set the secrets listed in .env.example.
